chunks: Ahmad ibn al-Hasan al-Qattan narrated to us, he said: Abd al-Rahman ibn Muhammad al-Hasani narrated to us, he said: Furat ibn Ibrahim ibn Furat al-Kufi narrated to us, he said: al-Hasan ibn al-Husayn ibn Muhammad narrated to me, he said: Ali ibn Ahmad ibn al-Husayn ibn Sulayman al-Qattan informed me, he said: al-Hasan ibn Jibra'il al-Hamdani narrated to us, he said: Ibrahim ibn Jibra'il informed us, he said: Abu Abdillah al-Jurjani narrated to us, from Nuaym al-Nakha'i, from al-Dahhak, from Ibn Abbas, he said:

I was sitting before the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) one day, and before him were Ali ibn Abi Talib, Fatima, al-Hasan, and al-Husayn (peace be upon them), when Gabriel (peace be upon him) descended to him with an apple in his hand. He greeted the Prophet with it, and the Prophet greeted Ali with it, so Ali greeted with it and returned it to the Prophet. The Prophet greeted with it and greeted al-Hasan with it, so he kissed it and returned it to the Prophet. The Prophet greeted with it and greeted al-Husayn, so al-Husayn greeted with it, kissed it, and returned it to the Prophet. The Prophet greeted with it and greeted Fatima, so she kissed it and returned it to the Prophet. The Prophet greeted with it a second time and greeted Ali with it, so Ali greeted with it a second time. When he was about to return it to the Prophet, the apple fell from the tips of his fingers and split into two halves. A light shone from it until it reached the sky of the world, and there were two lines written on it: In the name of Allah, the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate. This is a greeting from Allah, Mighty and Majestic, to Muhammad al-Mustafa, Ali al-Murtada, Fatima al-Zahra, and al-Hasan and al-Husayn, the two grandsons of the Messenger of Allah, and a protection for their lovers on the Day of Resurrection from the Fire.

key_terms.أَمَان: Protection - divine safeguard for the lovers of Ahl al-Bayt
key_terms.تَحِيَّة: Greeting - a salutation from Allah to the Prophet's family
key_terms.تُفَّاحَة: Apple - a heavenly apple brought by Gabriel as a divine gift

ai.seo_question: What was written on the heavenly apple Gabriel brought to the Prophet?
ai.summary: Ibn Abbas narrates that while he was sitting before the Prophet, with Ali, Fatima, Hasan and Husayn present, Gabriel descended with an apple. The Prophet greeted them with it in turns -- first Ali who returned it, then Hasan who kissed and returned it, then Husayn who kissed and returned it, then Fatima who kissed and returned it. When the Prophet greeted Ali with it a second time and Ali was about to return it, the apple fell from his fingertips and split in two, radiating light that reached the sky. Written upon it was: 'In the name of Allah, the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate. This is a greeting from Allah, Mighty and Majestic, to Muhammad al-Mustafa, Ali al-Murtada, Fatima al-Zahra, and al-Hasan and al-Husayn, the two grandsons of the Messenger of Allah, and a protection for their lovers on the Day of Resurrection from the Fire.'

en.bilal-muhammad: Ahmad b. al-Hasan al-Qattan narrated to us. He said: `Abd al-Rahman b. Muhammad al-Hasani narrated to us. He said: Furat b. Ibrahim b. Furat al-Kufi narrated to us. He said: Al-Hasan b. al-Husayn b. Muhammad narrated to me. He said: `Ali b. Ahmad b. al-Husayn b. Sulayman al-Qattan narrated to me. He said: Al-Hasan b. Jibra’il al-Hamadani narrated to us. He said: Ibrahim b. Jibra’il informed us. He said: `Abdullah al-Jarjani narrated to us from Nu`aym al-Nakha`i from al-Dahhak from Ibn `Abbas. He said:

One day, I was sitting before the Messenger of Allah (s). `Ali b. Abi Talib, Fatima, al-Hasan, and al-Husayn (as) were in front of him when Gabriel (as) came down with an apple in his hand. He gave it to the Prophet (s), then the Prophet gave it to `Ali (as), then he returned it to the Prophet (s). Then, the Prophet (s) gave it to al-Hasan (as). He accepted it and then returned it to the Prophet (s). Then, the Prophet (s) gave it to al-Husayn. He accepted it and then returned it to the Prophet (s). Then, the Prophet (s) gave it to Fatima. She accepted it and then returned it to the Prophet. Then, the Prophet (s) gave it to `Ali (as) a second time. When he wanted to return it to the Prophet (s), the apple fell from his fingertips. It split into two parts, and a light dazzled from it until it reached the sky of this world. Two written lines appeared on it: “In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful. This is a salutation from Allah to Muhammad the Chosen One (al-Mustafa), `Ali the One Pleasing to God (al-Murtada), Fatima the Radiant (al-Zahra’), and al-Hasan and al-Husayn the Two Clans of the Messenger of Allah (sibtay rasulAllah); and a [statement of] protection from the Fire for their lovers on the Day of Resurrection.”
